open: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input is the exact clean office background animation plate. Preserve every pixel position, camera, desk, stool, lantern, railing, dimensions. Make a second BACKGROUND plate for animation compositing. Remove the three ivory noren cloth panels ONLY, reconstructing the straight curtain rod and the wooden wall/shoji frame that they concealed. Below that rod, open the narrow sliding shoji door at the FAR RIGHT: its panel slides to the right off-canvas leaving one narrow open doorway, with a warmly dim wooden room inside. The vertical doorway starts immediately beneath the curtain and extends down to the rear veranda floor, behind the stool. Keep door jambs and lintel exactly fixed. Absolutely no human. Do not alter the furniture, props, lantern, ledger or seal holder on the desk. Same exact cropped image framing and rendering. This is an animation CLEAN PLATE used only behind the moving cloth and door.
tools: Use case: background-extraction. Reference image shows shrine clerk identity and style. Create a TRANSPARENT sprite sheet with FOUR equal columns ONE row, full-body SAME seated fox-masked female clerk in each, same scale, baseline and body placement as reference. No desk, seat, paper, scenery or background pixels. Black long hair tied with red cord, full fox mask on front of face, ivory kimono sleeves, vermilion hakama, white tabi. Fine illustrated pixel texture at character reference quality. All four seated facing LEFT, feet together, SAME hip and shoulder position, but she leans forward when reaching. Column1: leaning forward to LEFT, extending her right arm LEFT and DOWN, placing a slender writing brush horizontally on a low unseen tabletop; fingers hold it from above. Column2: empty right hand reaching far LEFT and DOWN to pick up an upright small wooden seal from a holder on the unseen tabletop, torso leans forward naturally, no brush. Column3: now upright seated, compact bent right elbow, right hand holds a small brown wooden seal upright above an unseen ledger directly in front of her, no brush. Column4: same pose as column3 but right hand lowers the seal vertically by a small distance, making a natural downward stamping press; no brush. Left arm consistent, resting forward on desk. Do NOT change legs or outfit between columns. Four separate full-body figures on genuine transparent alpha. No markings, labels or props floating separate from hands. Anatomically sound hands, no duplicate arms.
